component.name: Open Acrobat
component.summary: A fast, open-source Adobe Acrobat clone for Fedora, Linux, and cross-platform devices

description.p: Open Acrobat is a powerful, lightweight, and professional PDF editor and viewer built natively for Fedora Linux and cross-platform devices.

ul.li: Multi-page continuous PDF scrolling with thumbnail sidebar
Click & type text anywhere on PDF pages with instant save controls
Text highlighting, vector drawing, sticky notes, and stamps

description.p: Initial release of Open Acrobat with complete PDF editing, annotations, and cross-platform support.
